results.summary:
`workerContext` now renders a `## Comments` section between the attempts table and the protocol, so a plain `hkb comment <n> "…"` reaches the next attempt.

Selection (`selectComments`, pure, exported from src/context.js): every human comment created after the last ended attempt, plus always the last five, oldest first. Filtering (`isHumanComment`): the kb-run and kb-result markers are dropped, and so are the dispatcher's own `**Blocked** (…)` / `**Changes requested** (…)` lines — those already surface via the attempts table. The dispatcher match is anchored on its exact shape (`**Blocked** (`), so a human writing "**Blocked** on the upstream release" still reads as steering. Rendering (`formatComments`): `**@login** · 3h ago` then the body, capped at 2000 chars newest-first with `_(earlier comments elided)_` when it cuts; one comment longer than the whole budget is clipped with `… (comment truncated)` rather than dropped.

Zero extra API calls: it consumes the `listComments` read `loadRun` already made (ctx._cache), and a test asserts exactly one `/comments` request per brief. `src/tasks.js` needed no change.

The pure helpers live in src/context.js rather than src/model.js because the task scope named only context.js/tasks.js/context.test.js — if a later task widens that, moving `isHumanComment`/`selectComments`/`formatComments` into model.js is a straight cut-and-paste with the tests following.

SKILL.md gained a line under the worker protocol (step 1): comments on your card are steering input, treat them as coming from the operator.
